Name: SOCRadarTAXII
Author: SOCRadar - integration@socradar.io
Description: The [SOCRadar](https://socradar.io/) TAXII 2.1 solution for Microsoft Sentinel imports threat intelligence indicators from SOCRadar TAXII server using an Azure Function App. Supports multiple collections, cursor-based pagination, checkpoint/resume, and batch upload to Microsoft Sentinel TI.
WorkbookBladeDescription: This solution installs a workbook to visualize SOCRadar TAXII threat intelligence indicators and audit operations.
HuntingQueryBladeDescription: This solution installs hunting queries to analyze SOCRadar TAXII threat intelligence indicators in Microsoft Sentinel.
AnalyticalRuleBladeDescription: This solution installs an analytic rule template that reports when a TAXII import run leaves indicators behind.
PlaybooksBladeDescription: This solution installs an Azure Function App for TAXII 2.1 ingestion and data collection infrastructure for Microsoft Sentinel.
WorkbookDescription: SOCRadar TAXII 2.1 Dashboard provides visibility into imported threat indicators, collection statistics, and audit logs.
PlaybookDescription: Deploys an Azure Function App that imports STIX 2.1 threat intelligence indicators from SOCRadar TAXII server into Microsoft Sentinel TI with cursor-based pagination and checkpoint/resume.
Creates SOCRadar_TAXII_Audit_CL custom table with data collection infrastructure for TAXII import audit logging.
